profile.entities: Finolex Cables Ltd; Finolex-Sumitomo EHV JV; Dentsu One IR (moderator)
profile.subseg: Electrical (building wire, auto battery cable, industrial flexibles, power cable, agri, solar DC cable); Communication (optical fibre cable, OFC, copper comm); FMEG (PVC conduits, fans); EHV power cable JV (Sumitomo)
profile.themes: Data-Center (OFC demand driver, genuinely supplied); Grid-Capex (EHV JV power cables into utilities); Renewable-Integration (solar DC cables, near capacity); Defence (fibre pulled into military apps — but RM covenants restrict participation)

deepdive.sec: Wires & Cables / Optical Fibre & Power Cables (electrical infra + telecom transmission)

bull_bear.body: - Self-funded organic capex (~INR 300 cr); continued infusion/support to EHV JV now yielding returns. Inventory build (~INR 300 cr) is defensive working-capital, expected to unwind as costs pass through. No buyback/dividend/M&A commentary.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- Geopolitical (Mideast/Russia wars) → RM supply-chain disruption, fibre/germanium availability, INR depreciation.
- Germanium & imported glass/preform-input export restrictions (China/Europe) — defence-use covenants limit participation in lucrative military fibre demand.
- Copper price volatility suppressing retail housing-wire demand.
- FMEG (fans) structural underperformance.
- Fixed-price domestic OFC contract delays realization of high spot fibre prices to Q2FY27.
- Preform plant stabilization execution risk.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: New Deputy CEO/CFO Mahesh Viswanathan — candid, conservative, explicitly refuses to give guidance numbers in a volatile environment ("won't stick my neck out"). Detailed, numbers-grounded answers; honest about FMEG weakness and supply-chain constraints. Credible.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- Defence fibre demand is real but largely **inaccessible** to Finolex due to RM-supplier covenants — so the upside narrative is data-center, not defence.
- Preform = an option, not just cost-save: lets the company arbitrage between selling preform (when cable orders thin) vs converting to high-margin fibre (when fibre prices spike, as now).
- EHV JV inflection (first profit + 5x market expansion potential) is an under-discussed multi-year driver tied to grid capex.
- Comm revenue looks flat YoY but masks a sharp H2 price-led recovery whose P&L benefit is contractually deferred to FY27 — a setup for an FY27 step-up.
- Housing-wire weakness is a copper-price/destocking phenomenon, not end-demand collapse (project sales stable).
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- "Robust financial performance and a net zero debt balance sheet position the company to pursue growth opportunities and deliver sustained value to stakeholders."
- Debt to Equity (consolidated) of 0.00017x in FY26, versus 0.00019x in FY25 and 0.00009x in FY22.
- Net Worth grew to Rs. 5,099 Cr in FY26 from Rs. 3,264 Cr in FY22; Cash & Cash Equivalents at Rs. 163 Cr in FY26 versus Rs. 90 Cr in FY25.
- Consolidated ROE of 13.7% and ROCE of 13.6% in FY26 (ROE 14.2% and ROCE 15.6% in FY25).
- Net cash used in financing activities was Rs. -128.91 Cr in FY26 and Rs. -128.11 Cr in FY25; investing activities turned positive at Rs. +152.83 Cr in FY26 against Rs. -82.09 Cr in FY25.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- **Electrical (record INR 1,697 cr Q4):** Auto batteries +30% vol, industrial flexibles +17%, power +21% (all high-double-digit). Building/housing wire only marginal vol growth (copper price pass-through caused retail/dealer destocking; project sales stable). Agri apps down ~15-16% (monsoon). Retail:project mix shifted from ~80:20 to ~two-thirds:one-third. Util ~mid-60s (66%); ~15% headroom; max ~80-85%.
- **Communication:** ~75% of segment is optical-fibre. Draw capacity 4M km, utilization ~3.2/4M (~80%). Comm rev flat FY26 (~INR 500 cr) but Q4 +30%; volume +7%.
- **FMEG:** Underperforming ("under par"). Fans flat (BIS norm change → destocking + unseasonal rain). PVC conduits strong, ~85% util. Portfolio/team/distribution under review.
- **EHV JV (Sumitomo):** Turned profitable FY26 — first time after years of losses; blend of pure-supply (faster cash) + turnkey orders; higher voltage grades focus.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary stock(s) | Loser | Why / conviction |
|---|---|---|---|
| Global fibre shortage (data-center + defence pull) hardening prices | FINCABLES · 500144 (self) | Fibre/OFC buyers without preform integration | Owns preform + drawing; benefit deferred to FY27 by fixed contracts. Med-High |
| Germanium / glass / preform-input export curbs | Vertically backward-integrated preform players incl. FINCABLES · 500144 (self) | Pure preform buyers / drawers without RM contracts | "Glass not available for any money"; only long-term-contract holders supplied. Med |
| Grid capex / EHV cable demand ($0.5bn → $4-5bn) | FINCABLES · 500144 (self, via Sumitomo JV) | Late-entrant EHV competitors | JV finally profitable, >80% machine util, proprietary vertical-insulation tech. Med |
| Solar/renewable buildout (India + ex-China) | FINCABLES · 500144 (self, solar DC cable) | — | Near capacity, doubling line. Med |
| Copper price escalation → housing-wire retail destocking | — | FINCABLES · 500144 (self) & all building-wire makers | Retail/dealer reluctant to hold stock; vol flat. Med |
| FMEG (fans) BIS-norm destocking + competition | Established fan brands (code unverified) | FINCABLES · 500144 (self, FMEG) | Fan volumes flat; portfolio under review. Med |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- "A market-leading brand built on quality, safety and resilience—trusted by customers and positioned for long-term growth", with a 23.9% market share in the organised wire industry and a presence across 28 states and 8 union territories.
- Pioneer of India's cable & wire industry (established 1958, listed October 1983), credited with firsts such as manufacturing JFTC for DoT among Indian private sector players, FRLS wires and cables, LAN cables with UL verification, and power cables up to 500 kV through a joint venture.
- Extensive product portfolio spanning electrical wires & cables, telecom cables, lighting, electrical accessories, switchgear, appliances and smart home solutions, positioning Finolex as a comprehensive "Total Electrical Solutions" provider.
- Strategic technology tie-ups: "Harnessing advanced technologies and partnerships with leading technology providers to constantly upgrade product and process competencies and develop next-generation innovative solutions".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Distribution] Pan-India network of over 800 distributors, 5,000 channel partners and 2,15,000 retailers, with an aim to extend retail reach to 2,50,000 retailers, focusing on Tier 2 & 3 cities and rural areas and strengthening partnerships with real estate developers.
- [Fiber demand cycle] "A significant reversal in fiber market dynamics is a crucial enabler for margin recovery in this segment", driven by global defence applications, Data Center fiber requirements (US and India) and BharatNet Phase 3, with an emerging global shortage described as creating "a massive opportunity".
- [External shock] Others segment volumes were "impacted across the board following disturbances in West Asia – supply chain disruptions as well as lower fuel availability"; price erosion in Lighting continues to impact that business.
- [Credit rating] Crisil Long Term Rating of AA+/Stable (Reaffirmed).
- [Shareholding] Q1FY26 shareholding split: Promoters 35.9%, DII 16.7%, FII 9.7%, Others 37.8%.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body:
- Late-Q4 margin squeeze: Mideast shock → RM cost hikes across the board + INR depreciation + inventory cost creep; copper LME briefly low but offset by other RM.
- Opex & employee cost % of sales at 12-quarter lows; mgmt says annual level holds.
- Comm margin improvement (Q4 ~6% EBIT) driven by a few non-contract orders at current (high) fibre prices + scale; fixed domestic contract caps near-term upside.
- Germanium (for preform) is the key cost/supply chokepoint — few months' inventory.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
**This quarter (Q4/FY26):**
- Revenue +22% YoY/QoQ; electrical record INR 1,697 cr; Comm Q4 +30%.
- Preform plant commissioned (Mar-26, 100 MT Phase 1) — major backward-integration milestone.
- EHV/Sumitomo JV turned profitable first time (PBT ~INR 21 cr on ~INR 450 cr).
- ~INR 300 cr defensive inventory build post-Mideast shock; late-Q4 margin pressure.
- Solar DC cable near full capacity; doubling announced.

**Next-quarter watch items (Q1-Q2 FY27):**
- OFC fibre draw capacity 4M → 8M km completion (Jul/Aug); revenue potential ~INR 750 cr.
- Major OFC contract renewal (end-June) — confirm renewed & at higher prices.
- Preform stabilization & cost benefit (end-Q2/Q3); germanium supply.
- Comm EBIT margin trajectory toward 8-9% target.
- Solar line doubling progress; export ramp (target 2-3% share).
- FMEG/fans turnaround signs.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- Mgmt explicitly **declines formal guidance** given war/supply-chain volatility.
- Comm EBIT margin: did ~6% FY26; "should do better"; targets 8-9% by FY27 IF no supply-chain constraints (75% util scenario).
- Fibre price benefit to financials only from **~Q2FY27** (fixed long-term domestic contract runs to end-June; renegotiation expected).
- Preform benefit kicks in **end-Q2 / Q3 FY27** (3-4 month stabilization from Mar-26 commissioning).
- H2 FY27 should be "much better than last year" on Comm side, supply-chain permitting.
- Opex/employee cost % of sales: similar to FY26 on annual basis.
outlook.title: Guidance (next quarter / verify)

outlook.body:
- OFC: one major contract (>half of capacity), 8-yr relationship, up for renewal end-June FY27 — high confidence of renewal; balance sold to other customers. Specific OFC order-book number not disclosed.
- EHV JV: opened FY26 with ~INR 380 cr order book; key machinery >80% utilized; capacity expansion planned to lift overall plant util to 70-75%.
- EHV addressable market: $0.5-0.75bn today → could reach $4-5bn in 3-4 years (utility-led).
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- **Optical-fibre preform** (just commissioned, 100 MT Phase 1): backward integration → flexibility to sell preform OR convert to fibre/cable depending on market; expected ~5-10% cost advantage vs market once stabilized.
- **Fibre draw capacity doubling 4M → 8M km** (complete Jul/Aug FY27); post-expansion total OFC revenue potential ~INR 750 cr.
- **Solar DC cable:** introduced Q4FY25, near full capacity, capacity being doubled (part of new capex).
- **Data-center fibre** (India localization push + AI) = multi-year structural demand.
- **Exports:** revamped team; INR 30 cr (FY25) → INR 52 cr (FY26); revenue share <1% → targeting 2-3% over 2 yrs.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Steady electrical-cable cash cow funding an optionality call on optical-fibre: preform backward-integration just commissioned + fibre draw capacity doubling to 8M km into a globally tight fibre market (data-center + defence pull), with the long-loss-making EHV/Sumitomo JV finally turning profitable.

open.item: In-house FMEG manufacturing still on the cards but not this year — needs to hit volumes first.
No meaningful BharatNet contribution yet; of 16 tenders, 12 ordered (Finolex won none directly, pursuing sub-supply), 4 to retender (~September); 7 state tenders expected in next 2-4 months.
Incremental E-beam full-year revenue of ~INR200 cr expected starting FY26 (asset turn 2 rising to 4-5 on <INR100 cr capex).
Benefit of hardened fiber prices to show from ~Q2FY27, once fixed-price yearly contracts (valid until end June) are renegotiated.
Fiber draw capacity expansion (4M to 8M km) to be commissioned towards end of Q2FY27 (~July/August), giving 8M km from Q3FY27.
Preform plant commissioned mid-March 2026; will take another 2-3 months to settle and stabilize, benefit kicking in end Q2FY27 or Q3FY27.
Current FY27 capex includes doubling the solar cable line (nearing capacity utilisation), aiding both power cable and JV.
Communication segment EBIT (~6% this year) expected to improve, targeting ~9% at ~75% utilisation subject to no supply-chain constraints.
FY27 capex ~INR300 cr total: ~INR200 cr new capacity enhancement (incl. doubling solar line) + ~INR100 cr to complete optic-fiber preform/draw program.
Reaffirms FMEG target of INR500 crores by ~2028; states target is still within reach with new switch/switchgear and fan/water-heater launches.
Once preform line stabilizes, in-house preform expected to be 5-10% better than market cost (margin accretive).
Exports grew from ~INR30 cr (FY25) to ~INR52 cr (FY26); revenue share expected to climb from <1% to ~2-3% over next 2 years.
EHV market seen expanding from ~$0.5-0.75 billion to ~$4-5 billion over 3-4 years.
After 8M km expansion, total OFC/communication revenue potential ~INR750 cr (can exceed INR750 cr at today's high fiber prices, config-dependent).
No direct BharatNet Phase 3 position, but receiving inquiries from position-holders; hopeful of adequate business over the next two years.
Birla (cement group) wire/cable factory likely into production ~Q2/Q3 CY next year in direct wire competition; Adani plans unclear.
With the additional (8M km) capacity, total OFC/communication revenue can reach ~INR600-700 cr in a full year (design-dependent).
Once preform plant and additional fiber draw stabilize, communication segment margins (now lower single digits) can return to traditional 8-10% levels.
Considering in-house FMEG manufacturing or acquisitions; acknowledges need to look at it seriously (needs scale/valuations to match).
Electrical cable segment can reach ~INR6,500 cr peak revenue at current prices on ~INR700-750 cr gross block (~8x asset turn).
